text: うらぐちから　タダで　はいろうなんて　ちゃっかりもの　だね　それより　きみ　コハクって　しってる？

structure.jp: うらぐちから　タダで　はいろうなんて
structure.en: trying to get in free through the back door, of all things

structure.jp: ちゃっかりもの　だね
コハクって　しってる？

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて holds up what was just said with surprise or scorn; はいろう is 'meaning to go in'. はいろうなんて = 'trying to get in, of all things'.

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a word is a casual way to bring it up as the thing you are asking about. コハクって = 'this thing called amber'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている; with しる it gives the lasting state of knowing. しってる = 'do you know'.
